title: Version safety circuit with Terraform-hooked telemetry gates for private control plane upgrades
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Scope: Implement a 'version safety circuit' for Private (VPC) control plane upgrades that ties Terraform/IaC promotion steps to realtime telemetry gates. The circuit will allow the control plane to progress through staged promotions (pilot -> cohort -> regional -> global) only when a set of health signals and provenance checks pass. The implementation includes: Terraform module hooks that apply promotion flags, a small controller that translates promotion flags into in-cluster config, a telemetry gate evaluator that aggregates signals (latency P95, API error rate, reconciliation lag, etc.), and automated rollback actions if thresholds are exceeded. This ticket focuses on the orchestration wiring, Terraform hooks, and gating policy — not the low-level kernel changes or model artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A promotion invoked via Terraform applies a promotion flag and creates a Promotion CR that is visible in cluster. 2) The telemetry gate evaluator consumes metrics from the Console metrics API and returns a pass/fail within 30s for a given promotion window. 3) For a staged promotion (10% -> 30% -> 100%) the controller will only advance to the next stage when gates are green; otherwise it will pause and create a RollbackSuggestion event. 4) All actions are recorded in the Audit Log (KMS-backed) and associated with the Terraform run ID.
steps: Add hook in IaC pipeline to attach run_id and provenance checksum
Implement Promotion controller that reads Promotion CR and enacts fractioned traffic routing
Implement telemetry gate evaluator service with configurable signal thresholds
Expose promotion status in Console and emit audit events
notes: Goals: reduce blast radius for control plane upgrades and make rollouts auditable and reproducible from IaC. The Terraform hook must be idempotent and safe for re-runs. We will initially gate on control-plane API errors, reconciliation latency, and a synthetic end-to-end smoke test that exercises tenant admission and KV cache warmup. Later iterations can include model inference regressions and cost delta signals.
